welcome.title:
Your books.
Your files.
welcome.lead: Read and listen to the DRM-free books you already own.

private.title: Nothing gets uploaded.
private.local: Your ebooks and audiobooks stay on your device.
private.privacy: What you read is private. We never see titles or files.

progress.title: Never lose your place.
progress.sync: Only your reading and listening progress follows you between devices.
progress.autosave: Your spot is saved automatically, even offline.

bring.title: One library for reading and listening.

signIn.title: Last step: save your place.
signIn.lead: Your account keeps your progress in sync. Your books stay on this phone.
signIn.returningLead: Sign in to pick up where you left off. Your books stay on this phone.
signIn.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

email.title: Sign in with email.
email.lead: Use the email and password of your OwnBooks account.
email.label: Email address
email.invalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.

verify.title: Confirm your email.
verify.lead: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
verify.label: 6-digit code
verify.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
verify.invalid: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again, or send a new one.

errors.offline: You’re offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
errors.notConfigured: This build isn’t connected to a backend yet. See .env.example.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in option isn’t set up in this build.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

switch.title: This phone has books from another account.
switch.lead: They stay hidden while you’re signed in. You can remove them to free up space.

createAccount.title: Create your account.
createAccount.lead: We’ll email you a 6-digit code to confirm the address.
createAccount.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
createAccount.exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, or reset your password.

password.wrong: That email and password don’t match. Try again, or reset your password.
password.leaked: This password has appeared in a data breach elsewhere. Please choose another one.

forgot.title: Reset your password.
forgot.lead: We’ll email you a 6-digit code to set a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.lead: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}, then your new password.

empty.title: Your shelf is waiting.
empty.body: Bring an ebook or audiobook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.
empty.bodyAudio: Bring an audiobook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.
empty.bodyEbook: Bring an ebook you already own. Files need to be DRM-free.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Your listening and reading time will show up here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.signOutNote: Your books stay on this phone and come back when you sign in again.

import.inOrder: We put them in order for you.
import.untouched: Your original files stay untouched. Nothing is uploaded.

errors.title: This file can’t be added.
errors.drm: This file is DRM-protected (for example from Audible or Kindle). OwnBooks only plays DRM-free files you own.
errors.unsupported: OwnBooks supports MP3, M4B and M4A audiobooks and EPUB ebooks.
errors.duplicate: This book is already in your library.
errors.unplayable: This file couldn’t be played. It may be damaged or in an unusual format.
errors.noSpace: There isn’t enough free space on this phone for this book.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while adding this book. Nothing was saved.
errors.unreadable: This ebook couldn’t be opened. The file may be damaged or not a real EPUB.

import.rejectedSome_one: {{count}} file was skipped because it isn’t supported.
import.rejectedSome_other: {{count}} files were skipped because they aren’t supported.

errors.missingFile: This book’s files are missing from this phone. Import it again to keep listening.

player.sleepStopsIn: Stops in {{time}}. The timer only runs while the book plays.
player.sleepStopsAtChapterEnd: Stops at the end of this chapter.

book.deleteBody: This removes the book and its place from this phone. Your original files aren’t touched.
book.notFound: This book isn’t in your library any more.

reader.missingFile: This book’s file is missing from this phone. Import it again to keep reading.
reader.noContents: This book has no table of contents.
